cards.card_text: Crescent ornaments Golden bells Bronze clasps
cards.verse_text: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Get up and kill us yourself, for as the man is, so is his strength.” So Gideon got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and he took the crescent ornaments from the necks of their camels.
cards.snippet: …got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and he took the crescent ornaments from the necks of their camels.

cards.card_text: Earring after earring lands on a spread-out garment: 1,700 shekels of gold, plus crescent ornaments, pendants, the purple garments of Midian's kings and the chains off the camels' necks.
cards.verse_text: The weight of the gold earrings he had requested was 1,700 shekels, in addition to the crescent ornaments, the pendants, the purple garments of the kings of Midian, and the chains from the necks of their camels.
cards.snippet: …earrings he had requested was 1,700 shekels, in addition to the crescent ornaments, the pendants, the purple garments of the kings of Midian, and the…

cards.card_text: More gold: an earring of gold and an ornament of fine gold.
cards.verse_text: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear.
cards.snippet: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear.

cards.card_text: He keeps going: her cheeks are beautiful with ornaments, her neck with strings of jewels.
cards.verse_text: Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments, your neck with strings of jewels.
cards.snippet: Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments, your neck with strings of jewels.

cards.card_text: God says, 'His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols.'
cards.verse_text: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols.
cards.snippet: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images…

cards.card_text: The people made detestable idols out of beautiful ornaments.
cards.verse_text: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols.
